restated: When a Describe trigger is present, failure to open the AI-fill dialog or verify the native walk is recorded as an allowed skip, so a broken no-op or broken AI-enabled dialog path can pass with complete coverage. An absent trigger or a verified no-autofill navigation may remain an intentional skip.
